task.description: Implement requirements PRM-02 (Conflict pre-flight rejection), PRM-03 (Plan digest binds approval to a diff), PRM-04 (Promotion review state machine), PRM-05 (Non-skippable human approval gate) per the design artefact src/design/prm02-05-promotion-approval-pipeline.md on branch feature/WF02-prm02-05-20260816. Follow the WF-02 Step 2a procedure: verify you are on branch feature/WF02-prm02-05-20260816 first; read the design; read backend conventions; implement the Zig source (promotion conflict detection, plan digest canonical serialisation, promotion_reviews state machine, no-bypass approval gate, GET /api/v1/promotions/{id}/context with stored plan + digest + assertions[] + NEEDS_REVIEW package); write the SQL migration for the promotion_reviews table (13 columns, CHECK over the six status values, partial unique index promotion_reviews_plan_digest_active_uniq over (tenant_id, plan_digest) WHERE status IN ('pending_review','approved')) per the design spec; emit DEFINITION_PROMOTION_REJECTED / _APPROVED / _APPLIED events in the correct transactions; run zig build check and zig fmt --check scoped to your changed files; apply migrations to the test DB. Address the design's Open questions / reconciliation notes (digest entry shape vs requirement {type,id,changes}; context handler must serve assertions[] and NEEDS_REVIEW; approve/markApplied must emit the events in-transaction). Acceptance criteria are the PRM-02..05 ACs in docs/requirements.yaml.
acceptance_criteria: zig build check exits 0 (build + formatting gate)
Migration applies cleanly to the test DB and creates promotion_reviews with CHECK + partial unique index

PRM-02 ACs: HTTP 409 PromotionConflict with per-conflict {definition_id, source_change, target_change}; exactly one DEFINITION_PROMOTION_REJECTED event; no promotion_reviews/promotion_assertion_runs row; no transaction open against target tenant schema at conflict raise

PRM-03 ACs: deterministic 64-char lowercase hex SHA-256 digest over canonical JSON; 409 PlanDigestMismatch on approve/apply mismatch; review stays pending_review; context serves stored plan not live diff

PRM-04 ACs: 6-state CHECK + permitted transition edges; 400 InvalidReviewTransition; 409 DuplicateReview via partial unique index; approved->failed on assertion re-run failure; approved->applied with DEFINITION_PROMOTION_APPLIED in same transaction as pointer move

PRM-05 ACs: apply without approved review returns 400 and claims no sandbox; self-approval returns 403 and stays pending_review; no skip field in schema (422 on unknown field); context response contains plan, assertions[], NEEDS_REVIEW, plan_digest in one document

result.summary: Implemented PRM-02..05 reconciliation per src/design/prm02-05-promotion-approval-pipeline.md: OQ1 canonical plan digest over the requirement entry shape {type,id,changes} with changes={after,before,change_kind} (serialisePlanCanonical); the stored serialised plan is the same canonical JSON so a reviewer can recompute the digest (PRM-03 AC5). OQ3 approveReview/markReviewApplied now append DEFINITION_PROMOTION_APPROVED / DEFINITION_PROMOTION_APPLIED in the SAME transaction as the optimistic-locked status transition; the conflict path now appends DEFINITION_PROMOTION_REJECTED to the per-tenant events table (public.events no longer exists after GBL-112/PAR-01). OQ2 GET /api/v1/promotions/{id}/context now serves assertions[] and needs_review_package derived from the stored plan in one document with plan_digest (PRM-05 AC5). Gates: zig build check exit 0; zig fmt --check scoped exit 0; migrations applied to the test DB (096 conforms: 14 cols, chk_promotion_reviews_status CHECK over six statuses, promotion_reviews_plan_digest_active_uniq partial unique index). Also fixed pre-existing Zig 0.16 compile breakage in the promotion modules (ArrayList.empty, Sha256.hash options arg, std.crypto.timing_safe compare, route handlers' review.* optional derefs).

issues.description: Prior-batch PRM-02..05 integration test files (prm02_conflict_test.zig, prm03_digest_test.zig, prm04_review_sm_test.zig, prm05_review_gate_test.zig, promotion_reviews_test.zig) were never compiled/run on main and carry extensive pre-existing breakage: wrong bpm shim export names (bpm.promotion_plan vs promotion_plan_mod), broken format strings (trailing commas inside multiline JSON, literal-brace escaping), invalid try+catch, removed Zig 0.16 std APIs (ArrayList.init, std.crypto.utils, fmtSliceHexLower), AuthContext shape mismatch (.roles vs .role), nonexistent plat_events table, unquoted hyphenated schema names in SET search_path, and fixture allocation leaks. Acknowledged debt for TEST-DESIGNER (Step 3/4) to rewrite; not fixed here to keep the diff scoped. NOTE for test authors: the new approve/apply event appends resolve the per-tenant events table, so tests must route via tenant_default,public (all-zeros tenant) or a real tenant schema — public.events no longer exists.

Design OQ-2 interpretation: assertions[] and needs_review_package are derived from the STORED plan (one HumanReviewAssertion per plan entry, shape {id,description,severity,rule,sources}) because the promotion artifact store is not yet wired in this batch. PRM-05 AC5 'one document' is satisfied. Flagged so the interpretation is explicit, not silent.

DEFINITION_PROMOTION_APPROVED/_APPLIED/_REJECTED are not seeded in event_type_registry; the events table has no FK to the registry (the ES-05 check lives in Store.appendPlatform), so direct appends work — consistent with the existing DEFINITION_PROMOTION_REJECTED behavior. Possible follow-up to seed the types.
